lines: Hi! Sorry to keep you waiting!{be01}\nWelcome to the world of Pokémon!{be01}
My name is Birch.{be01}\nBut everyone calls me the Pokémon\nProfessor.{be01}
This is what we call a “Pokémon.”{be01}\nThis world is widely inhabited by\ncreatures known as Pokémon.{be01}
好的。\n能告诉我你的名字吗？
All right, are you ready?{be01}\nYour very own adventure is about\nto unfold.{be01}
Take courage, and leap into the\nworld of Pokémon where dreams,{be00}\nadventure, and friendships await!{be01}
Well, I’ll be expecting you later.\nCome see me in my Pokémon Lab.{be01}
And last... your partner!{be01}\nWill your first Pokémon walk with\nyou wherever you go?{be01}
